source_row.rationale: Gentamicin has potentially serious nephrotoxic and ototoxic effects. Current labeling recommends monitoring serum concentrations when feasible to assure adequate levels and avoid excessive peak or trough concentrations associated with toxicity.
source_row.source_detail: Warnings/Monitoring: serum concentrations, peak and trough limits, nephrotoxicity and eighth-cranial-nerve toxicity; current label accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.stem: Why are serum gentamicin concentrations monitored in selected clients receiving systemic therapy?
